budgetRejectedCoverage.limitation: Projected-cell occupancy and ROI bbox intersections are test-only geometry proxies. ROI entries without worldBBoxEstimate cannot be assigned chunk IDs; profile handles are not tied to chunks by this mapping. No semantic or AutoCAD coverage is implied.

sparseRoiPriorityModel.roiWeighting: Each target ROI has total weight 1; an intersecting candidate chunk contributes 1 / candidateChunkCount until that ROI's candidate set is fully selected.
sparseRoiPriorityModel.score: Sum of marginal target weights divided by estimated CPU bytes; ties prefer more marginal coverage, then vertex yield per CPU byte, then chunk ID.
sparseRoiPriorityModel.fallback: When no sparse target has remaining marginal coverage, use vertex yield per estimated CPU byte.

cameraViewportGridPriorityModel.targetDefinition: Each cell intersected by at least one Model chunk bbox inside the measured initial camera viewport is a target cell; cells without candidate geometry are excluded from the denominator.
cameraViewportGridPriorityModel.cellWeighting: Each target cell has total weight 1; an intersecting candidate chunk contributes 1 / candidateChunkCount until the cell is represented.
cameraViewportGridPriorityModel.score: Sum of remaining cell weights divided by estimated CPU bytes; ties prefer marginal cell count, then vertex yield per CPU byte, then chunk ID.
cameraViewportGridPriorityModel.fallback: When all candidate cells are represented, use vertex yield per estimated CPU byte.
cameraViewportGridPriorityModel.limitation: Bbox-cell intersection is compared with a test-only projection of compiled stroke segments and fill triangles. The projection does not apply dash gaps, wipeout subtraction, layer visibility, paint overlap, anti-aliasing or the final GPU raster; it is not pixel fidelity, readability or semantic importance.

projectedPrimitiveGridModel.targetDefinition: 20x20 cells aligned to the host's 1 CSS px padded world viewport, occupied by compiled drawCommands or renderer-compatible legacy layerRuns/raw line and triangle arrays from at least one Model chunk; cell occupancy is coarse and chunk-specific.
projectedPrimitiveGridModel.score: Sum of remaining projected cell weights divided by estimated CPU bytes; ties prefer marginal cell count, then vertex yield per CPU byte, then chunk ID.
projectedPrimitiveGridModel.limitation: Exact centerline-segment/cell intersections and triangle-cell overlap are geometric estimates before final draw behavior. Dash phase, wipeout subtraction, layer visibility, renderer lineweight width, occlusion/order, anti-aliasing, text readability and AutoCAD parity are not modeled.

projectedRasterComparison.note: Raster is the actual partial host frame. Cell membership needs three pixels differing from corner background by at least the tested RGB-channel delta (8, 16, 32, or 64); coarse occupancy is not pixel-fidelity scoring.

admissionOrderWhatIf.limitations: Counterfactual only: estimated geometry/source costs start at zero and omit renderer fixed overhead, shared backing stores between chunks, and concurrent completion order. Reordering may change measured geometry costs. Sparse bbox ROI means fewer than 10% of model chunks intersect the provisional profile bbox; the score uses profile boxes, not the current camera viewport. One selected representative is not full ROI coverage. A higher vertex count or bbox coverage does not prove viewport readability or native fidelity.

chromiumProcessRss.note: Per-process working sets; summing them can double-count shared pages.

limitations: This browser sample measures the current parser output; it is not clean-decode or AutoCAD semantic acceptance. Prior R001 decoder suites report LibreDWG error 68.
WebGL bufferData byte total is upload-call volume, not live GPU residency or physical GPU allocation.
JSHeapUsedSize is a Chromium page metric; process RSS is per-process Windows working set and shared pages can be double-counted.
Host resource events expose temporary admission estimates and cache reasons; they are estimates, not physical GPU allocation or a whole-process peak measurement.
P00 ROI coverage is bbox-to-chunk fetch mapping; without the native AutoCAD oracle it is not visual/semantic ROI parity.

The 5x5, 10x10, and 20x20 camera grids count chunk-bbox intersections inside the measured initial viewport; cells without candidate chunks are excluded, and coarse cell occupancy is not pixel coverage, line density, readability, or semantic importance.

The additional projected occupancy samples compiled stroke centerlines, tests fill-triangle intersections and optionally expands centerlines by a diagnostic CSS-pixel radius. It omits dash gaps, wipeout subtraction, layer visibility, overlap/paint order, anti-aliasing and GPU pixels; expanded masks are geometry proxies, not the renderer lineweight model or raster/AutoCAD fidelity.

Raster occupancy compares the actual partial Chromium canvas screenshot against its sampled corner background. It counts occupied 20x20 cells, not pixel-level visual similarity; R001 still reports LibreDWG error 68.

The first-content WebGL raster uses one synchronous default-framebuffer readPixels after the first accepted draw task. It is not a compositor-presented screenshot, can stall the browser/GPU, and may perturb chunk-delivery timing.
